results.title: El retrato
results.overview: Valentina, a young painter who takes care of her sick father, receives the visit of death, who announces that her final time has arrived. In an attempt to get more time to take care of his father, he proposes a deal: Portray her to prolong her life.

results.title: Bazooka
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of mysterious abductions across Brazil, mother and son, Marta and Levi, struggle with affection and grief when one of their loved ones, Diná, a young trans woman, becomes one of the victims.

results.title: Borrón y Vida Nueva
results.overview: Ulises wakes up in a hospital "with no memory". Now he'll reclaim the life he lost: the ex who keeps to stalking her, the business that was stolen from him, and the house of his dreams; however, not everything is as he remembered it.

results.title: Our House
results.overview: A successful sales executive and his pregnant wife find their dream home. But after moving in, strange occurrences begin to happen, while a mysterious connection between the husband and the house next door emerges.

results.title: LIFE
results.overview: In the year 3000, a young boy explores an enchanting forest, but his peaceful journey is interrupted by a stark reality: a desolate, war-torn landscape. "LIFE" is a poignant and visually striking short film that challenges us to reflect on the urgent need to save our planet.

results.title: AAA Guerra de Titanes 2025
results.overview: The 2025 Guerra de Titanes was a professional wrestling event produced by Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide, in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Saturday, December 20, 2025, at Arena Guadalajara in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. It was the 26th Guerra de Titanes show promoted by AAA since 1997, and was the first Guerra de Titanes to be held under WWE's ownership of AAA.

results.title: Remi & Nneoma
results.overview: It is a contemporary Nollywood adaptation of the biblical story of Ruth and Naomi, set within an Ikwerre community in Nigeria and exploring themes of grief, loyalty, and the challenges of widowhood.

results.title: Three Cats: Time Travel
results.overview: A full-length cartoon for the 10th anniversary of beloved characters.

results.title: NJPW World Tag League 2025 - Day 15
results.overview: The fifteenth night of the World Tag League 2025 heavyweight tag team tournament took place on December 10, 2025, at 	Dejima Messe Nagasaki in Nagasaki, Japan, and featured the semi-final match between the top B block teams.

results.title: Deeper
results.overview: In a remote part of New Zealand, lies a cold, dark and mysterious cave system with the potential to be the deepest dived cave in the world. It’s here that explorer and hero of the Thai cave rescue Richard “Harry” Harris is searching for a sense of self. There’s no question that this is the highest stakes dive he has ever attempted. Underground, underwater, with a finite amount of gas to breathe, it’s a dangerous game to play. So what drives Harry to continue in his pursuit when he knows the cost - not just to himself, but to those he loves - and will he make it back to them?

results.title: The Carolers
results.overview: A December night of carol-singing for cash sends three young bandmates headfirst into mischief, mistakes, and growing up.

results.title: Christmas Everyday
results.overview: When a water pipe bursts and disrupts her sister's wedding plans, Fancy finds herself drawn to the rugged yet charming contractor. Through all the chaos, she learns valuable lessons about faith, family, and the true meaning of Christmas.

results.title: The Veil
results.overview: While learning of her parent's divorce, a young teenager meets a stranger in the woods who claims to be responsible for her soul.

results.title: Old Goat
results.overview: A family struggles to care for their aging grandfather who has turned into an animal.

results.title: Meets the World
results.original_title: ミーツ・ザ・ワールド
results.overview: Yukari adores the manga "Meat Is Mine", but she can't bring herself to like herself. Watching her friends leave one after another due to marriage, childbirth, and other life events, she feels anxiety and impatience about continuing to live this way. One day, while passed out drunk in Kabukicho, she is rescued by Rai, a hostess harboring suicidal thoughts.

results.title: Control Freak
results.overview: A motivational speaker, plagued by an uncontrollable itch on her head, becomes infected with a parasitic demon from her homeland.

results.title: Claudia de Breij: Wat als
results.overview: With music and stories, Claudia de Breij paints a portrait that blends domestic details with global news: being kind, wanting to be seen, overstimulation, abstinence, dictators, and restaurant tunes.

results.title: Tito Lastarria
results.overview: Tito Lastarria, better known as the “Chilean Vampire,” is the subject of a documentary that explores his legend through the collective perspective of the city where he was born, where the memory of the vampire and his legend still endure. Set in Cemetery No. 1 in Rancagua.
